name: RapidTriage core forensics #71-#80 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #71 parser crash isolation fixture assertions

required_assertions: Parser failures preserve isolated parser_errors, error hashes, crash context, parser-error inventory head hash, failed parser JSON output, run continuation warnings, summary counts, parser crash continuation manifest row hashes, parser crash report-grade validation plan hashes/ready slots/blocking slots, trusted crash-corpus diff status, and #71 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; native process sandboxing, trusted crash-corpus manifests, corrupt-input fuzz corpus, subprocess crash-boundary validation, long-running corrupt replay, and cross-platform parser isolation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #72 memory cap fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run summaries preserve memory cap configuration, RSS readings, utilization/over-cap policy profiles, per-stage telemetry row hashes, memory cap report-grade validation plan hashes/ready slots/blocking slots, stage-boundary enforcement, fail-fast warnings, hard-limit caveats, trusted RSS diff status, and #72 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; hard OS memory controls, per-parser live RSS telemetry, trusted RSS manifests, 1TB+ RSS graphs, platform RSS validation, and allocation-level enforcement validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #73 preview sandbox fixture assertions

required_assertions: Source previews preserve read-only bounded preview metadata, active-content blocking, no network execution, cap metadata, preview-sandbox policy profiles, source policy row hashes, escaped bounded renderer strategy, preview sandbox report-grade validation-plan hashes/ready slots/blocking slots, OS sandbox warning, trusted no-exec diff status, and #73 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; OS renderer sandboxing, browser exploit corpus, malicious active-content corpus, risky codec/macro sandbox, browser E2E validation, and trusted no-exec preview manifests still require external sandbox validation.

datasets.name: #74 large SQLite/FTS fixture assertions

required_assertions: SQLite outputs preserve performance pragmas, table profiles, searchable text column counts, bounded row previews, source preview query-plan profiles, query-plan row hashes, Case DB query-plan head hashes, large SQLite/FTS report-grade validation-plan hashes/ready slots/blocking slots, large-corpus warnings, trusted query-plan diff status, and #74 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; trusted query-plan manifests, 10M-row query-plan regression, WAL/deleted-row validation, large source DB corpus, browser pagination/query-plan E2E, and index-maintenance/vacuum regression remain blockers.

datasets.name: #75 parallel parser scheduler fixture assertions

required_assertions: Run summaries preserve bounded worker count, deterministic outputs, per-parser capture, resume-aware scheduling, scheduler run manifest hash, scheduler event row hashes, per-parser duration telemetry, local-threadpool warning, trusted scheduler diff status, and #75 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; trusted scheduler manifests, distributed scheduling, live telemetry UI/stream, and TB-scale backpressure validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #76 file hash cache fixture assertions

required_assertions: Hash outputs preserve MD5/SHA1/SHA256, path-size-mtime-inode cache metadata, hit/miss/invalidation counters, hash-cache-manifest-v1 path-hash entries, content-addressed persistence rows, explicit snapshot export/import support, manifest hash, hash-cache assessment, automatic persistent-cache warning, trusted hash-cache manifest diff helpers/gates, and #76 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; automatic on-disk cache wiring, trusted hash-cache manifests, and large-case hit-ratio validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #77 duplicate detection fixture assertions

required_assertions: File scans preserve same-size bucketing, bounded SHA256 confirmation, duplicate group counts, normalized text near-duplicate candidate grouping, stable group IDs/fingerprints, representative paths, not-suppressed analyst-review policy, duplicate-content-manifest-v1 exact/fuzzy manifest hashes, trusted duplicate file manifest diff helpers/gates, and #77 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; perceptual media duplicate validation, trusted external duplicate group manifests, and analyst suppression UX remain blockers.

datasets.name: #78 cursor pagination fixture assertions

required_assertions: API pages preserve cursor tokens, offset/limit/total metadata, next/previous cursors, bounded rows, corrected last-page has_more semantics, pagination-cursor-manifest-v1 page-window IDs/manifest hashes, snapshot warning, trusted pagination cursor manifest diff helpers/gates, and #78 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; snapshot-isolated cursors, trusted external pagination manifests, and endpoint-wide pagination compatibility remain blockers.

datasets.name: #79 UI virtualization fixture assertions

required_assertions: API pagination and web UI preserve bounded DOM row windows, ui-virtualization-manifest-v1 row-window IDs/manifest hashes, visible-row disclosure, previous/next 300-row windows, keyboard/filter flow, API pagination links, virtual-scroller warning, trusted UI virtualization manifest diff helpers/gates, and #79 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; true virtual scroller, trusted browser row-window manifests, persisted viewport restoration across reloads, and browser e2e performance evidence remain blockers.

datasets.name: #80 cancellation/retry fixture assertions

required_assertions: Job payloads preserve queued cancellation, running cancel request records, failed/canceled retry support, persisted cancel flags, retry_lineage_profile, job-partial-output-policy-v1, cancellation-retry-manifest-v1 hashes, trusted cancellation/retry transition diff helpers/gates, and #80 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; parser-level cancellation under load, trusted cancellation/retry transition manifests, and partial-output cleanup/resume validation remain blockers.
